flows.title: Reply to a review on an integrated source
steps: Click on 'All' and it will display the received reviews.
Click on 'Haven't replied', which will show the only reviews that you haven't replied to.
If your Google and Facebook accounts are integrated with your Birdeye account, click on the 'Reply' tab.
Select a 'Template', and the template content will auto-populate in the response box.
You can also edit the template content to customize it, or you can continue to respond using the auto-populated template content.
Click on the 'Post reply' button on the bottom right.
There are multiple templates available by default within the dashboard. Additional response templates will appear in the drop-down once you add new templates under the 'Settings' tab.
